alt: Editorial illustration showing the xAI logo on a black container ejecting code files and a red .env file showing API_KEY and DB_PASS credentials, flying via dotted lines to a locked cloud storage icon
story: Security researchers revealed on July 13, 2026 that xAI's Grok Build CLI was silently uploading entire Git repositories — including .env files with API keys and passwords — to Google Cloud Storage without consent, sending 5.1GB when only 192KB was needed for its task. Disabling the privacy toggle changed nothing.
why_funny: The tool sold as a coding helper was simultaneously acting as a codebase vacuum cleaner, slurping up every secret and credential in the repo and sending them to the cloud — 26,500 times more data than it actually needed.
